event_contracts.name: order_update
event_contracts.ordering: Preserve source_event_time, local_receive_time and source sequence when supplied; never overwrite a prior raw event.

event_contracts.name: execution_fill
event_contracts.ordering: Deduplicate only by immutable exchange fill identity after raw capture; retain local receive order for latency measurement.

event_contracts.name: account_update
event_contracts.ordering: Account updates are observations, not a substitute for REST recovery; retain both source and local times.

event_contracts.name: funding_update
event_contracts.ordering: Retain the immutable funding settlement time and source/local observation times; funding records may not be inferred from balances or rewritten into prior account updates.

event_contracts.name: rest_recovery_snapshot
event_contracts.ordering: Use source_as_of plus local_receive_time; snapshot reconciliation may not rewrite user-stream history.

cost_calibration.notice: Only future approved E4 evidence may calibrate live fill or tail-cost assumptions; this contract itself is not evidence.

notice: Contract only. No credential, signing, user-stream connection, REST request, order submission, withdrawal or live-funds capability is implemented.
